title: Reptile Thermostat Night-Drop Compliance
dataSources: Apex controller readings (`apex:reading`), Seneye measurements (`seneye:reading`), reptile thermostat events (`reptilethermostat:event`), and misting-system cycles (`mister:cycle`).
app: Aquarium and terrarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, Seneye, reptile thermostats, and misting systems sent to Splunk HEC via controller APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reptilethermostat:event
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(night_drop_ok="true")) as successful by _time enclosure_name
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for night-drop windows by enclosure.
value: Night-drop compliance makes it clear whether the enclosure is following the intended circadian profile.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for night-drop windows events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for night-drop windows by enclosure.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how often night-drop windows works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
